title: Seedling light trial
question: Does blue light change seedling height?
minimum_evidence: A reviewed confirmatory result that passes the registered support rule without unresolved validity or control failures.
decision_change_criteria: Keep white light if the registered falsifier appears.
Do not choose blue light if measurement validity is contradicted.
ambiguity_questions: Could tray position or baseline vigor explain an apparent height difference?
Would a contradicted measurement-validity check change the decision regardless of the point estimate?

claim_boundaries.statement: The registered height measurement is usable for this study.
claim_boundaries.scope: Greenhouse height measurement for this fixture protocol.

claim_boundaries.statement: Blue-light assignment is associated with seedling height.
claim_boundaries.scope: This greenhouse contrast and dataset only.

available_data_sources: Greenhouse height CSV exported from the registered measurement sheet.
Light-meter calibration log retained as PDF.
unavailable_data: No baseline stem-height photograph exists before assignment.
data_access_constraints: Raw tray labels remain local until privacy review.
data_provenance_plan: Hash source bytes, retain collection context, and record custody before analysis.
ethical_constraints: Avoid avoidable seedling stress outside the assigned light exposure.
Stop collection if greenhouse safety or access restrictions are active.
ethical_safeguards_plan: Review greenhouse access and plant-stress constraints before collection; stop and record a deviation if a constraint is exceeded.
sampling_plan: Randomly sample eligible pots from one tray.
randomization_plan: Randomize pots to light before measurements begin.
calibration_plan: Verify the light meter against a reference before each collection day.
measurement_validity: Measure a marked stem with a calibrated ruler.
analysis_commitment: Estimate the mean difference and a confidence interval.
